description: This PHP class 'FormatWithPayGradeId' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to format a value into a pay grade name by retrieving the PayGrade entity with a specific ID using a service container.

classes.name: FormatWithPayGradeId
classes.description: A class that formats a PayGrade ID to its name using dependency injection and service locator pattern.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the name of the PayGrade corresponding to the given ID, or null if not found.
